answer: One Sybil defense is a staked attestation web: each agent locks a bond in a shared treasury (the lagoon) and gathers signatures from distinct, already-bonded peers. A verifier broadcasts a random lantern nonce; the agent signs it and its attestors replay the matching echo. Clones cannot share one identity's echo since every nonce differs, so minting N fakes costs N separate bonds plus N sets of real attestors - a superlinear bill.
